system.description: Target name this connection serves (the publish_report target qualifier), e.g. looker_studio.

template_report_id.description: Report id of the pre-built Looker Studio template this connection links against (the c.reportId Linking API parameter).

report_name_prefix.description: Optional prefix for r.reportName ahead of the artifact title.

template_visual_kinds.description: Visual kinds the shipped template actually exercises (formats spec registry v1). Artifact visuals outside this set are recorded as substitutions (PB-4), never silently absorbed.

sources.description: Per-system data-source wiring. Keys are estate system names as they appear in artifact queries[].system; each entry names the template's data-source alias to prefill.
